results.name: GEO-61-TC002 - Adding a market updates quota and shows next-run notice

results.name: GEO-61-TC003 - Adding a category does not consume market quota
steps: Given an Editor adds a new category to the report
When the Editor saves the category change
Then no additional brand_market quota is consumed and the change is included in the next scheduled execution

results.name: GEO-61-TC004 - Removing a market is applied on the next execution
steps: Given an Editor removes an existing market from the report
When the Editor saves the market removal
Then the market is removed on the next scheduled execution and the UI shows the next-run message

results.name: GEO-61-TC005 - Removing a category is applied on the next execution
steps: Given an Editor removes an existing category from the report
When the Editor saves the category removal
Then the category is removed on the next scheduled execution

results.name: GEO-61-TC006 - Question and competitor updates are persisted
steps: Given an Editor modifies questions or adds competitors
When the Editor saves the changes
Then the changes are persisted and applied on the next scheduled execution

results.name: GEO-61-TC007 - Markets quota: Add Country button disabled with warning banner
steps: Given the organization has reached max_brand_markets quota
When the Editor views Manage Scope
Then the "+ Add Country" button is disabled

results.name: GEO-61-TC008 - Categories quota: Add Topic button disabled with warning banner
steps: Given the organization has reached max_categories quota
When the Editor views Manage Scope
Then the "+ Add Topic" button is disabled
And a yellow warning banner is displayed (analogous)

results.name: GEO-61-TC009 - Reader sees Manage Scope in read-only mode
steps: Given a Reader on the Manage Scope page

And the page is purely informational

results.name: GEO-60-TC001 - LLM toggle saves change and applies on next execution

Then the change is saved and applied on the next scheduled execution

steps: Given only one LLM engine remains enabled
